title: Remote artifact fetched without an integrity check during the build in dockerfile — review required
description: ADD with an http or https source downloads content into the image without verifying a checksum or signature. The build trusts whatever the remote host returns at build time, so a compromised or replaced artifact enters every image built from the recipe. The rule flags the remote ADD; whether the artifact is pinned elsewhere is a review decision.
remediation: Download in a RUN step, verify a published checksum, and only then place the artifact in the image.
limitation: Lexical: matches ADD with a remote URL; a following RUN that verifies a checksum is not linked to the download.
